mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE revision_chain AS ( SELECT id pi_id,id source_pi_id,previous_revision_id,0 depth FROM bike_pi WHERE id IN #{piId} UNION ALL SELECT chain.pi_id,previous.id,previous.previous_revision_id,chain.depth+1 FROM revision_chain chain JOIN bike_pi previous ON previous.id=chain.previous_revision_id WHERE chain.depth < 99 ) SELECT chain.pi_id,chain.source_pi_id,chain.depth,step.status,step.detail_json FROM revision_chain chain JOIN bike_pi_workflow_step step ON step.pi_id=chain.source_pi_id AND step.step_code='PURCHASE_CONTRACT_READY' ORDER BY chain.pi_id,chain.depth

SELECT so.stock_out_no stock_no,batch.execution_pi_id FROM bike_stock_out_record so JOIN bike_stock_out_batch_item item ON item.stock_out_id=so.id JOIN bike_stock_out_batch batch ON batch.id=item.batch_id WHERE so.stock_out_no IN #{stockNo}
